name: dyn_err_undefined_ref
source:
DYNAMIC undef (method = ode45, time = 0 .. 10, points = 3)
  der(Level) = Nope
  Level(0) = 0
END

error.message: DYNAMIC undef (per-step algebraic solve at time = 0.0): There are 3 equations and 4 variables. The problem is underspecified and cannot be solved. Free quantity (no defining relation): nope. Coupled to: der.level. A common cause: an element chain with no constitutive law for that quantity — e.g. an efficiency-only machine or rigid pass-through between boundaries leaves its through-flow or a port pressure free; add an orifice/valve/flow-map element or pin a boundary value. A common cause: a branch with no flow-determining element (an efficiency-only machine or rigid pass-through leaves its through-flow or a port pressure free) — add an orifice/valve/flow map, pin a boundary, or use method = ida for genuinely derivative-coupled networks.
